tests.name: 真实本地服务：无配置、编辑、包往返、字幕待配置、错误与窄屏操作
飞书UI契约：普通导入提示旧包，明确确认后刷新企业附件并呈现保留企业版结果
模型高级设置UI契约：输出上限整数校验与DeepSeek官方host专属推理选项
模型诊断UI契约：失败回答仅按需读取并单独展开，不发起模型请求
MiniMax提示UI契约：精确官方主机显示原生路径，独立配置不复制模型或密钥

boundary: One real local CRUD/ZIP/subtitle-waiting-config/mobile flow in temporary data; four explicit Feishu/model-setting/diagnostics UI contracts. No user data, real credentials or real Douyin login were involved.
relationship_to_final_build: This 5-test run used index-IXkYamCk.js, before saved-session check and in-page QR/restart changes. It was not rerun after those changes; the final 4-test contract report identifies its own newer build.
